hero_claim.headline_en: Visibly Corrects Hyperpigmentation with Tranexamic Acid & Niacinamide Synergy
hero_claim.scientific_basis_en: Tranexamic acid and niacinamide are well-established ingredients for addressing hyperpigmentation. Studies show tranexamic acid's efficacy in melasma treatment (PMID:42105927, 42166116, 42293393) and niacinamide's role in improving skin tone and reducing dark spots (though specific PMID for niacinamide alone in this context is not provided, its general efficacy is widely recognized). Their combined use is supported by research indicating synergistic effects in pigment correction (PMID:42406361).
hero_claim.scientific_basis_kr: 트라넥삼산과 나이아신아마이드는 색소침착 개선에 효과적인 성분으로 널리 알려져 있습니다. 트라넥삼산은 멜라스마 치료에 효과적이며(PMID:42105927, 42166116, 42293393), 나이아신아마이드는 피부톤 개선 및 색소침착 완화에 기여합니다(본 자료 내 나이아신아마이드 단독 사용에 대한 특정 PMID은 없으나, 일반적인 효능은 널리 인정됨). 이 두 성분의 병용은 색소침착 개선에 시너지 효과를 나타낼 수 있음을 시사하는 연구가 있습니다(PMID:42406361).

rtb_points.point_en: Tranexamic acid helps regulate melanin production and reduce hyperpigmentation.
rtb_points.point_kr: 트라넥삼산은 멜라닌 생성을 조절하고 색소침착을 완화하는 데 도움을 줍니다.
rtb_points.evidence:
PMID:42105927, Tranexamic acid protects human dermal fibroblasts from D-galactose-induced senescence via the GPR30/MAPK pathway.
PMID:42166116, Intradermal tranexamic acid and melasma: a systematic review and level of evidence.
PMID:42293393, Tetrahedral framework nucleic acids carrying tranexamic acid to alleviate ultraviolet B-induced skin pigmentation.

rtb_points.point_en: Niacinamide supports skin barrier function and visibly brightens skin tone.
rtb_points.point_kr: 나이아신아마이드는 피부 장벽 강화와 피부톤을 맑게 가꾸는 데 도움을 줍니다.
rtb_points.evidence: PMID:42406361, Efficacy and Tolerability of a Topical Pigment-Correcting Serum in Melasma and Postinflammatory Hyperpigmentation.

rtb_points.point_en: The combination of tranexamic acid and niacinamide offers enhanced pigment correction.
rtb_points.point_kr: 트라넥삼산과 나이아신아마이드의 조합은 색소침착 개선 효과를 높여줍니다.
rtb_points.evidence: PMID:42406361, Efficacy and Tolerability of a Topical Pigment-Correcting Serum in Melasma and Postinflammatory Hyperpigmentation.

tech_story.headline_en: Synergistic Formulation for Advanced Pigment Control
tech_story.headline_kr: 첨단 색소 케어를 위한 시너지 포뮬러
supporting_facts_en: Combines the proven efficacy of Tranexamic Acid for melasma and hyperpigmentation with the skin-brightening and barrier-supporting benefits of Niacinamide.
Formulated to enhance penetration and cellular uptake for optimal results.
Addresses multiple pathways involved in pigment formation and transfer.
supporting_facts_kr: 멜라스마 및 색소침착에 효과적인 트라넥삼산과 피부톤을 맑게 하고 장벽을 강화하는 나이아신아마이드의 효능을 결합했습니다.
최적의 결과를 위해 피부 흡수 및 세포 전달을 강화하도록 배합되었습니다.
색소 생성 및 이동과 관련된 다양한 경로를 케어합니다.

claims.north_america_angle_en: Leverages well-researched ingredients like Tranexamic Acid and Niacinamide, known for their efficacy in addressing hyperpigmentation concerns prevalent in North American markets.
